policy.name: Warden of both exits
policy.lesson: I stand on the window first, then the door. I ignore glass and guard the exits, not the relic.

reply:
I followed the skill's playbook. The keeper goes to the window first and camps on it. He then drops down to guard the front door, and the loop repeats. I set skepticism to 2 so decoys can't pull him off the exits. I set protectRelic to false because he would reach the vault too late. I kept the dwell short at 1 second so he doesn't leave the door unguarded for long.

```json
{
  "name": "Warden of both exits",
  "decoySkepticism": 2,
  "protectRelic": false,
  "dwell": 1,
  "patrol": [{ "x": 19, "y": 10 }, { "x": 3, "y": 18 }],
  "lesson": "I stand on the window first, then the door. I ignore glass and guard the exits, not the relic."
}
```
